description: DISRUPTIVE: stop a running server — it goes offline until started again with upcloud_start_server. soft (default) sends an ACPI shutdown; with a timeout, a hard stop follows if it is still running. hard is like pulling the plug and can lose unsaved data. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/stop.

stop_type.description: soft = ACPI shutdown signal (default); hard = equivalent of pulling the power cable.

name: upcloud_stop_server
title: Stop a server
